items.title: GTA 6 Reportedly Reaches Massive Milestone Just On Pre-Orders
The PlayStation 5 version of GTA 6 has shown a huge lead in pre-orders compared to Xbox.
GTA 6's First TV Ad Cuts The Spicy Shower Scenes
Rockstar Games Reveals GTA VI Launch Trailer
items.summary: After a busy few weeks in Miami with GTA VI's marketing increasing on a daily basis, Rockstar Games finally unveiled the game's latest trailer, 5 weeks out from launch.
points: The fourth official trailer went up on 15 October, about five weeks before launch.
It runs 1:29 and leans on Jason's backstory alongside in-game action.
Rockstar added a Newswire post and new artwork on the official site, the same art seen on a Brooklyn mural that week.

items.title: GTA 6 PlayStation Worldwide Release Countdown
items.summary: Official PlayStation Store listings reveal the exact GTA 6 launch times across 63 countries and regions, beginning in New Zealand and progressing through 15 release windows across 19 hours.
points: The PS5 digital version unlocks region by region, between 11:00 UTC on 18 November and 06:00 UTC on 19 November.
New Zealand goes first, at midnight local time on 19 November.
A few countries still have no confirmed time, and the schedule covers PS5 digital only.

items.title: Exclusive: GTA 6 Beer Labels for Pißwasser, Patriot and "No Mames Vice City" Discovered in Official US Database
items.summary: Three beer labels that may be tied to GTA VI showed up in a US federal alcohol registry, all filed by a Florida brewery.
points: Three GTA-style beer labels (Pißwasser, Patriot, No Mames Vice City) are listed in the US alcohol label registry.
All were filed by a brewery in Doral, Florida, and approved between late September and mid October 2026.
Rockstar hasn't announced a beer tie-in, so the link is unconfirmed.

items.title: GTA 6 launch day is officially one month away
items.summary: With a month to go, pre-orders are open, pre-loading starts on November 12, and the Standard and Ultimate editions sit at $79.99 and $99.99.
points: One month to go until the 19 November launch.
Standard costs $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition $99.99.

items.title: GTA VI Merch Scalpers Are Charging Up To 2,735% More Than The Rockstar Store
items.summary: Resellers list official GTA VI merch on eBay far above retail, while some of the same items are still sold by Rockstar at the normal price.
points: Rockstar's GTA VI merch went on sale on 8 October and many UK items sold out.
Resale listings on eBay ask many times the store price.
Some items are still sold by Rockstar at the normal price, so the article suggests waiting for restocks.

items.title: GTA 6 locks in Nov. 19 release date after delays
items.summary: The November 19 launch is confirmed, with digital pre-downloads opening a week earlier on November 12.

items.title: Watch the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
items.summary: Rockstar released the launch trailer about a month before the game arrives on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
points: The Launch Trailer is out on Rockstar's YouTube channel.
GTA VI arrives 19 November 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Pre-orders remain open on the official site.
